**6h**

I am finishing my Starbie from week 1 of Half-life. I wasn't able to finish it during week 1 so I am glad that this week incorporates the use of LED screens so I can finish what I began in week 1. I am trying to make improvements in the code so that I can make my sprite original. I wasn't able to do the coper under plating like it recommended so I had to wire all the grounds together.
